Class BoardEvaluator

java.lang.Object
chess.ai.BoardEvaluator
public class BoardEvaluator extends Object
Scores a position for the minimax search: positive is good for the side asked about.

The score is material (each piece's PieceType.getValue()) plus a small positional bonus: pawns are worth more as they advance, and knights and bishops are worth more near the center. Scores are in centipawns, so 100 means "about one pawn better".
